description: This is a PHP source file responsible for rendering the detailed view of a HelpDesk ticket in the vtiger CRM system. It includes logic for fetching ticket data, permissions, template handling, comment display, related lists, and rendering the Smarty template for the detail view.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering views in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches display blocks for the current module in the detail view.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Retrieves update information for the record.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions on the record or module.

methods.name: fetchWordTemplateList
methods.description: Retrieves list of templates for mail merge related to the HelpDesk module.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for the given module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into individual components for client-side validation.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related lists for the current module and record.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks specific field permissions for the current user.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Determines the availability of certain buttons/actions in the UI.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves database validation rules for the module's fields.

methods.name: getCommentInformation
methods.description: Retrieves comments related to the ticket record.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if the current module has related lists to display.
